description: Search and compare real flights for a route and dates, or re-read an earlier board. A fresh search starts a server-side provider search job and retains its board; it does not book or purchase a flight. origin and destination take an IATA airport or metro code, or a plain city or airport name that is resolved here; when several cities match or none does, the reply is an error carrying candidates, so ask the traveler and search again with a code. Pass searchId to filter, sort or re-read a board without another scrape; a partial board can gain fares when read again. Every fare carries the quote of each site that answered. Never imply a site that did not answer was searched. Returned amounts, minTotalAmount and maxTotalAmount are whole-party integer minor units; maxTotal and minTotal take normal currency units and priceBasis says whether they mean the party or a seat. Lead with the per-seat price and its seats multiplier when the party buys more than one seat, then name the whole-party total once. Clock filters are local to each departure or arrival airport. For a deadline such as home by Sunday evening resolve the exact date and use returnArriveBy; arriveBy is the outbound equivalent. bookingUrl opens the exact itinerary on bookOn, itineraryUrl is that provider's own page, sourceUrl is research evidence only. Attach a fare with add_to_trip source 'flight', this searchId and the fare's offerId. Prices are indicative until the traveler books. Returns data plus display.resultId; call display_card to show it.

airlines.description: Only these IATA carrier codes on every segment

arriveAfter.description: HH:MM local at the outbound destination

arriveBefore.description: HH:MM local at the outbound destination

arriveBy.description: Absolute outbound arrival deadline YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the arrival airport local calendar

cabin.description: economy = the standard cabin | premium_economy = the extra-legroom cabin | business = lie-flat or wide seat | first = the top cabin

cabinBag.description: Only fares including a cabin bag

checkedBag.description: Only fares including a checked bag

currency.description: ISO pricing currency; defaults to the traveler's home currency

departAfter.description: HH:MM local at the outbound origin

departBefore.description: HH:MM local at the outbound origin

departDate.description: Outbound date, YYYY-MM-DD, within 330 days. Omit only when refining with searchId.

destination.description: Where it lands: an IATA airport or metro code, or a city or airport name. Omit only when refining with searchId.

excludedAirlines.description: Exclude these IATA carrier codes from every segment

infants.description: Infants under 2; at most one per adult

limit.description: Maximum fares to return, in requested sort order. Use 1 for one flight or 3 for three; default 3. Return fewer only when fewer are available. Maximum 60.

maxDurationMinutes.description: Maximum elapsed journey duration in EACH direction, including connections

maxLayoverMinutes.description: Maximum ground time at EVERY connection; nonstop fares remain eligible

maxStops.description: Maximum connections in EACH direction; 0 means nonstop

maxTotal.description: Fare ceiling in normal currency units; priceBasis defaults to total

maxTotalAmount.description: Whole-party fare ceiling in integer MINOR units, regardless of priceBasis

minLayoverMinutes.description: Minimum ground time at EVERY connection; nonstop fares remain eligible

minTotal.description: Fare floor in normal currency units; priceBasis defaults to total

minTotalAmount.description: Whole-party fare floor in integer MINOR units, regardless of priceBasis

origin.description: Where the flight starts: an IATA airport or metro code (LHR, LON), or a city or airport name resolved here ('Lisbon' becomes LIS). Omit only when refining with searchId.

ids.description: Exact returned offerId values, in the order to display and compare. Refine with search_flights and the original searchId. Missing or duplicate IDs fail.

limit.description: Displayed fares: use 1 for one or 3 for three. Overrides the legacy result limit; never pads missing fares.

sections.description: Optional sections to show. Flight identity, price, booking and add actions remain available.

priceBasis.description: Reads minTotal and maxTotal only. total = the whole party's fare (default) | per_person = the budget is per adult or child seat, infant costs still included

returnArriveAfter.description: HH:MM local at the return destination; requires returnDate

returnArriveBefore.description: HH:MM local at the return destination; requires returnDate

returnArriveBy.description: Absolute home arrival deadline YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the home airport local calendar; requires returnDate. Use for home by Sunday evening instead of a clock-only filter.

returnDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD for the return; omit for one way

returnDepartAfter.description: HH:MM local at the return origin; requires returnDate

returnDepartBefore.description: HH:MM local at the return origin; requires returnDate

searchId.description: Refine an earlier board instead of scraping again: the searchId that search returned, retained for about 90 minutes. Route, dates, party, cabin and currency stay as they were; filters and sort narrow what was retained.

sort.description: best = balanced price, time and connections (default) | cheapest = lowest whole-party fare | fastest = shortest elapsed journey | fewest_stops = fewest connections

name: search_flights
title: Search and compare flights
